internal.cv: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by patient (no patient in both train and test)

external.note: HyperKvasir has no Mayo-0 class; images labelled 1-2 are excluded from the binary test

ablation_crohnipi_features.note: LIMUC 5-fold patient-grouped CV, same LR head; features from the CrohnIPI fine-tuned fold-1 EfficientNet-B0 instead of ImageNet

screen.train: SEE-AI (18,481 images, image-level labels from expert boxes)
screen.note: SEE-AI has no patient IDs, so internal CV is frame-level (optimistic); the Kvasir-Capsule external test is the honest number.

flare.label_def: Flare = HBI >= 5 at the next visit (<= 8 weeks later) for a patient currently in remission (HBI < 5)
flare.cv: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by patient, repeated 5x; 95% CI = patient-level bootstrap of averaged OOF predictions

kvasir_full.note: 5-fold EfficientNet-B0 ensemble trained on CrohnIPI only; single view, no TTA (same as the app); lesion score = 1 - P(normal)

quality_filter_rejected.cv: 5-fold GroupKFold by video; threshold per fold keeps >=98% of training inflammatory frames
quality_filter_rejected.decision: rejected: removes too many real lesion frames on held-out videos

polyp_localisation.note: findings screen trained on SEE-AI capsule frames; HyperKvasir = colonoscopy (other camera and organ)

uc_video_test.note: UC grader trained on LIMUC; HyperKvasir colitis videos (type not specified) vs BBPS 2-3 clean-bowel videos; 1 frame/s

kvasir_full_v1.note: 5-fold EfficientNet-B0 ensemble trained on CrohnIPI only; single view, no TTA (same as the app); lesion score = 1 - P(normal)

kvasir_full_v2.note: 5-fold EfficientNet-B0 ensemble trained on CrohnIPI only; single view, no TTA (same as the app); lesion score = 1 - P(normal)

hard_negative_head.note: Frozen v2 fold-1 backbone; only the final layer retrained. Every 10th frame of the 43 labelled Kvasir-Capsule videos; each video scored by the head trained with the OTHER half's negatives. Settings fixed before the first run.

hard_negative_gpu.note: Every 50th frame of the 43 labelled Kvasir-Capsule videos; each video scored by the model trained WITHOUT its half; baseline = original CrohnIPI fold-1 model on the same frames
